reviews.comment:
Nafta no cargo allí....pero....el restaurante es excelente.....minutas, carnes, pastas, bebidas grandes, todo muy bueno, muy recomendable para el que está de paso o laburando....

Los mozos muy atentos, los precios razonables,  el café en vaso premium.

Párrafo para Rubén, el mozo Santiagueño de Termas, es un capo, la deja chiquitita.....

(Translated by Google)
I don't fill up there... but... the restaurant is excellent... quick meals, meats, pasta, large drinks, everything is very good, highly recommended for anyone passing through or working...

The waiters are very attentive, the prices are reasonable, and the coffee is served in premium cups.

A special mention for Rubén, the waiter from Termas de Río Hondo in Santiago del Estero; he's a pro, he blows everyone else out of the water...

reviews.comment:
La atención fue esmeradamente buena en las oficinas del ACA. Pusieron mucha voluntad para que pudiera solucionar un problema y explicaron cosas dedicándome mucho tiempo. Fue más de un empleado el que actuó de esa manera.
Los baños estaban limpios y la cafetería sirvió un rico café con leche a un precio moderado, cosa que a la vera de una ruta no es común.
Un lugar recomendable.

(Translated by Google)
The service at the ACA offices was exceptionally good. They were very willing to help me solve a problem and took a lot of time to explain things. More than one employee acted in this way.
The bathrooms were clean, and the cafeteria served a delicious café con leche at a reasonable price, which is unusual on the side of a highway.
A highly recommended place.
